name: St Mary Magdalene and St Augustine, Burnley
shortName: St Mary Magdalene and St Augustine

boundary.description: From the confluence of Moor Isles Clough with the River Calder, S by the River Calder to M65 Motorway and W to the Green Brook. N from the M65 Motorway by the Green Brook to Knots Lane, and Scott Street, and Crowley Crescent (both sides of all these three streets in St Mary Magdalene's parish), to Padiham Road and W by Padiham Road to junction with Kiddrow Lane N by a straight line to the confluence of Whittaker Clough and the River Calder, E by the River Calder and its confluence with Moor Isles Clough.
